## Scope

Describe the Pro integration change and why it does not belong in Community.

## Verification

- [ ] Client and/or billing checks pass.
- [ ] Authorization failure and resource-limit paths are tested.
- [ ] No secrets, license tokens, private keys, or captured payloads are included.
- [ ] Camera data remains local by default.
- [ ] Planned capabilities are not represented as shipped.
- [ ] Protocol/security changes were made in Community first.
